$comment: Shared sample-screen manifest for the memory family (shots tool). One source for page names, demo memory items, suggestions, per-page presets and the clock across iOS, Android debug and Web dev shot entries. All three ends render the same values (iOS is the gold reference); every end builds in-memory items from this file through its production model builders and never writes a real store or touches the network. Item fields follow shared/context-contracts/memory-items.v2.json; omitted fields take the contract defaults. A conflict pair shares conflictGroupId = the original item's id; the other one (id ≠ conflictGroupId) is this device's copy. Keys starting with '$' are documentation and ignored by readers.
$hasRecentConversations: false on every page: no recent conversation exists, so the 'draft from recent chats' row / button stays hidden on all three ends. Conflict copies (id ≠ conflictGroupId) carry deviceId and show as this device; mutationId is derived from id; occurredAt is full RFC3339 (contract), midnight UTC of the event day; suggestions render in the production repository order (createdAt newest first: c-1, c-3, c-2).
